comments.body: Landed 2026-10-28: since in the daemon (2b8d3ff5..b7d4b79b) and the panes topic (e54980f2..956453ed): whole pane on appear/change, id on close, title alone raises no event, state rule shared in muster-daemon-proto (Pane::state/shown_state), API 0.2. creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-10 stage 1, part 2 of 5: the panes topic. Read docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md sections 3 and 4 ("Panes").

What: panes in the snapshot and as events (appears, changes, closes), as typed fields carrying what `muster window --json` gives today: id, callsign, given name, title, machine, directory, harness, state, facts, unread_input, context used, model, cost, session, maker, hidden, quiet, adapter reporting. And `since` as the daemon saw it: the daemon starts recording when an agent entered its current state where it publishes a state change, and carries it across a handoff. Unknown when the daemon did not see the change (after a restart), never filled with a client's first sight. Today the daemon keeps no such time: crates/muster-cli/src/windowless.rs returns since_ms 0 and the window counts from first sight (crates/muster-seam/src/session.rs). Consider having `muster window` with no window open print the daemon's `since` too.

Proves: a gate test client sees a pane appear, change state with a `since` that matches the transition, and close; a daemon handoff keeps `since`; a restarted daemon reports `since` as unknown.
title: MIP-10 stage 1b: the panes topic, with a since the daemon keeps
